title: Reassigned Numbers Database Cost: $8 Buys 1,000 Checks
meta_description: The FCC’s Reassigned Numbers Database costs from $8 for 1,000 checks a month, and it is the only lookup tied to the TCPA safe harbor for reassigned numbers.
secondary_keywords: is the reassigned numbers database free

image.takeaway: Checks cost from $8 for 1,000 a month. Only this database carries the safe harbor for reassigned numbers.
image.alt: Reassigned Numbers Database cost: one-month subscriptions start at $8 for 1,000 checks, and the FCC database is the only lookup tied to the TCPA safe harbor for reassigned numbers in 47 CFR 64.1200(m)
